# Empty, and empty is the intended state. This file held one entry,
# GO-2026-6909 in crewjam/saml, accepted from v3.490.0 because the advisory was
# marked Fixed in: N/A and there was no version to move to. v0.5.2 fixed it on

# advisory (grit#187).

# Before adding a line here, try to make the pin move instead. govulncheck is
# static, so a runtime flag never makes a finding go away: the symbol stays
# reachable from main whatever the condition says. An entry is an accepted risk,
# not a silenced warning, and it belongs in the template's copy too
# (internal/scaffold/api_ci_files.go, govulncheckAllowTXT).
